provenance._comment: Entries copied from actionstate-muse's packs name their source key; the snapshot test (test/history-view.test.ts) holds them to test/fixtures/history-view/muse-source.json. Once actionstate-muse deletes its history.page.* words, this pack is the source.

entries.badge.private: PRIVATE · for you only. Never send this page.
entries.badge.anyone: What this node gives anyone who asks
entries.built.owner: As of {at}. It is a snapshot, not a page that updates itself.
entries.built.recipient: As of {at}. It is a snapshot, not a page that updates itself.
entries.verdict.pass.all: every signature checks, including the answer's own, by the node's published key
entries.hero.failed: This history didn't verify, so this page shows none of it.
entries.hero.refused.reason: Its reason, in its own words: “{reason}”
entries.hero.unreadable: This page could not read the answer, so it shows none of it.
entries.hero.deals.picked.one: 1 deal {name} picked · steps recorded, not outcomes
entries.hero.deals.picked.other: {n} deals {name} picked · steps recorded, not outcomes
entries.hero.none.deals: There are no deals in this store yet.
entries.chip.recorded: Each step recorded as it happened
entries.slot.second.by: {by} signed this record too · {at}, by their clock
entries.periods.heading: Service History: exchanges served in each closed week
entries.callout.heading: What this does not show
entries.callout.checkpoints: These checkpoints show when this node's log was cut and how much it holds. They don't show what any exchange said or how it went, and this is not a judgment of the node.
entries.callout.deals: “Steps recorded” is this side's record of each deal, not a confirmed outcome.
entries.callout.deals.picked: {name} picked these; it isn't every deal. “Steps recorded” is {name}'s side's record, not a confirmed outcome.
entries.shares.heading: What this node shares
entries.shares.summary: With anyone who asks: a summary of its checkpoints, meaning how much it has recorded and when, and nothing about any exchange.
entries.shares.standard.off: The Service History: only the other side of an exchange gets it (off for anyone else on this node).
entries.shares.segments.counterparties: Only with the other side of an exchange, when they ask: that exchange's record.
entries.shares.segments.peers: With any node that signs its request: an exchange's record.
entries.shares.segments.off: The other side of an exchange can't ask for its record (off on this node).
entries.shares.segments.off.sealed: They still get the sealed record when it completes.
entries.shares.corroboration.on: With any node that asks by an exchange's id: whether this node holds its half (ids and digests only).
entries.shares.completion.on: Sent on its own: the sealed record when an exchange completes.
entries.shares.completion.off: The sealed record isn't sent when an exchange completes (off on this node).
entries.shares.adjudications.on: If this node judges an exchange, its verdict goes to the node judged.
entries.shares.adjudications.off: Verdicts this node reaches aren't sent to the nodes judged (off on this node).
entries.shares.dealhalf.counterparty: Only with the other side of an exchange: that exchange's half of the record.
entries.shares.stranger: With anyone who asks, even a stranger: {items}.
entries.shares.stranger.none: Nothing else goes to a stranger.
entries.shares.twins.on: When two copies of a model answer differently, this node sends the question and both answers to a referee.
entries.shares.unstated.standard: whether its Service History goes to anyone
entries.shares.unstated.segments: whether the other side of an exchange can ask for that exchange's record
entries.shares.unstated.corroboration: whether it tells a node that asks by exchange id if it holds that exchange's half
entries.shares.unstated.completion: whether it sends the sealed record when an exchange completes
entries.shares.unstated.adjudications: whether its verdicts go to the nodes judged
entries.shares.unstated.twins: whether it sends differing answers to a referee
entries.shares.unstated.never: whether a record goes to someone who doesn't prove who they are
entries.shares.witnesses: Signed checkpoints go to the witnesses named here: {witnesses}
entries.shares.witnesses.none: No witnesses named in this node's settings now. A row's time-stamp may come from an earlier setting.
entries.shares.never: Never: a record to anyone who doesn't prove who they are.
entries.shares.as_of: Set by this node as of {at}.
entries.seal.title: Locked as it happened.
entries.seal.checkpoints: Each checkpoint is signed and extends the one before, so a change to what it covers shows.
entries.seal.deals: Each step was saved as it happened. Any change to a saved step shows.
entries.seal.second.label: Second signature
entries.seal.second.some_failed: {k} of {n} didn't verify; see each row
entries.seal.directory: Signers are looked up at {directory} on every read, so that site can see each time you look.
entries.checked.heading: How this was checked
entries.checked.where.page: These checks ran in this browser when the page opened ({by}).
entries.checked.where.builder: These checks cover the records as of {at} ({by}).
entries.check.refusal: The refusal is signed by the key that answered
entries.check.artifact_digest: The answer's file is the bytes its digest names
entries.check.card_digest: The history card (history_card/1) matches its digest
entries.check.checkpoint_signatures: Every checkpoint is signed by the key that answered
entries.check.checkpoint_chain: Each checkpoint names the one before
entries.check.consistency: The log only grew between checkpoints: nothing removed or changed
entries.check.anchor: The last checkpoint is the one the answer names
entries.check.period_counts: The Service History's counts (service_history/1) match its checkpoints
entries.check.envelope_signature: The answer itself is signed by the key that answered
entries.check.key_is_node: The signing key is the node's published key
entries.check.reply_bound: The answer is bound to the request it answers
entries.check.second_signature: A second party signed this record
entries.check.deal_report: Each deal was read with its own report, which writes nothing
entries.refused: This page can't show this history: {reasons}
